description.value: Green Leaf Aburi Sushi is a North Vancouver outpost of a small Metro Vancouver sushi chain known for aburi-style preparations and a menu spanning traditional favourites to innovative creations. The Lonsdale location offers dine-in seating in a casual setting and accepts phone orders for takeout. It is one of four chain locations spread across the region, each operating independently with its own contact details.
